results.title: Watch: eMudhra key leak to PHP2Shell: How vulnerable is India’s digital infrastructure? | Business Matters
results.content: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella’s warning over the PHP2Shell crisis highlights growing cybersecurity risks. A cryptographic flaw at eMudhra, an SBI customer data leak and critical PHP vulnerabilities reveal how weaknesses across digital infrastructure can threaten internet security, expose personal data and undermine trust. Could quantum-safe technology help build a more resilient internet?
